name: mantine-components
description: A Mantine component registry, authored in Mantine vocabulary and compiled with manteen-kit.

scripts.//test: The house smoke test imports the kit by package name, which now resolves through its exports map into dist — so the kit has to be built before the suite runs.
scripts.//typecheck: guard-workspace runs first because a broken node_modules makes tsc report hundreds of errors in files nobody touched. Checking link integrity costs a few milliseconds and turns that wall into one actionable line. `astro check` runs last because the root tsconfig's include covers registry, test and packages only: apps/docs needs Astro's own compiler for .astro files, and its .tsx needs Vite's ambient types (import.meta.glob) that plain tsc does not have. Without this leg the docs app - playground shell, adapters, catalog previews - is typechecked by nothing at all; astro build only strips types.
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/guard-workspace.mjs && tsc --noEmit && bun --cwd=apps/docs run check
scripts.//guard: Every mechanical guard in one place. CI invokes them individually so a failure names itself in the job log.
scripts.guard: node scripts/guard-workspace.mjs && node scripts/guard-runtime-apis.mjs && node packages/cli/scripts/guard-diagnostics.mjs && node scripts/guard-release.mjs
scripts.verify:node: bun run build:kit && node packages/registry-kit/dist/cli.mjs build
scripts.docs:dev: bun run build:registry && bun --cwd=apps/docs run dev
scripts.docs:preview: bun run build:registry && bun run build:site && bun --cwd=apps/docs run preview
scripts.verify:docs: bun run build:kit && node packages/registry-kit/dist/cli.mjs build examples/registry-starter/manteen.registry.json examples/registry-starter/public/r && bun run build:registry && bun run build:site
scripts.verify:docs:consumer: bun run build:kit && bun --cwd=packages/cli run build && node scripts/verify-registry-starter.mjs
